frizzlebob_s_mission_control.1: Go everywhere on the map with Cartography Sidequest and prove to the machine you surveyed every inch of your own cage.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.2: Reach the end of the Level Goal, and your reward is a slightly harder level.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.3: Find an exit to The Maze? Spoilers, there is no outside.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.4: It's All Upstairs From Here, so you ascend a tower to fight a guy who could have just met you in the lobby.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.5: Run or Die, so go that way and don't stop. The illusion of choice, accelerated.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.6: Escape Sequence runs you away from danger until you reach safety, and safety is a cutscene.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.7: Rise to the Challenge, climb up until you reach safety, and gravity is now a microtransaction.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.8: At the Broken Bridge you cannot pass until the developers finish coding the next zone.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.9: The Boss Battle monster exists solely to gatekeep your dopamine.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.10: In Kill Enemies to Open you are the janitor of death.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.11: Mass Monster-Slaughter kills many of the same monster, because repetitive labor is fun when it's violent!
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.12: The pinnacle of heroic fetch quests is 20 Bear Asses for an NPC.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.13: The hitlist in Gotta Kill Them All is a psychopath's grocery run.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.14: A Kill Streak without getting hit is perfect for your anxiety!
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.15: In Player Versus Environment the computer is controlling the game against you, and the house always wins.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.16: Player Versus Player is divide and conquer, so keep the plebs fighting each other.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.17: An Escort Mission with a suicidal AI is the ultimate test of your patience.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.18: Gotta Rescue Them All is just a hoarding pathology disguised as altruism.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.19: Stand in this circle and Hold the Line until we say you can leave.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.20: Save the Princess, who's been kidnapped again, and try better locks next time.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.21: On a Fetch Quest for an NPC you are an intern with a sword.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.22: Chain of Deals is bureaucracy as gameplay, so trade items for items for items.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.23: The Product Delivery Ordeal is Postmates, but with dragons.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.24: Collect the Plot Coupons to open the door, the narrative equivalent of a punch card.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.25: In Gotta Catch Them All, wildlife preservation is a hostage situation.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.26: On a Herding Mission the AI pathfinding is a joke we play on you.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.27: In the NPC Round-Up Mission you are wrangling digital toddlers.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.28: Live Items are living creatures you stuff into your infinite pocket, so don't think about the ethics.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.29: In a Companion-Specific Sidequest your ally's loyalty is bribed, because friendship is transactional.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.30: Complete your ally's Loyalty Mission, or they betray you at the finale.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.31: Love in the Romance Sidequest is simulated, so select dialogue option C to receive affection.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.32: A shiny hat is the Cosmetic Award that validates your hundred hours of meaningless grinding.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.33: Solve the Stock Video Game Puzzle, because the ancient architect loved pushing ice blocks around.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.34: A Mini-Game is a distraction game with its own rules, and pacing is a myth.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.35: With Variable Player Goals, why save the world when you could take photos of frogs?
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.36: The Instant-Win Condition is a deus ex machina, so press X to end the simulation.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.37: For 100% Completion your digital grave requires all the shiny trinkets.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.38: In Gameplay Grading the machine judges your worth.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.39: Collect all the hidden rocks for the Secret Ending, and the true lore is disappointing.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.40: Your Bragging Rights Reward is an achievement that literally nobody else cares about.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.41: Normal misery wasn't enough, so you do a Challenge Run with optional restrictions.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.42: A Self-Imposed Challenge with your own restrictions is the Expert Edition of Stockholm Syndrome.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.43: With No Item Use for You, hoard the mega-elixirs until the credits roll.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.44: The No-Gear Level is a sudden, arbitrary strip search by the developers.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.45: A Speedrun skips the story and breaks the physics.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.46: Stepping on a twig in a Stealth-Based Mission is an instant fail.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.47: Time runs out in a Timed Mission, so the stress is artificial and so are the stakes.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.48: In a No-Damage Run one microscopic pixel of a hitbox ruins five hours of work.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.49: The Cake is a Lie and the reward was bait, so destroy the facility.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.50: Find the Princess in Another Castle, except your reward is a fungal hallucination.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.51: Players who Collect 12 Logs have tunnel vision and are forgetting how to actually play.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.52: Set your own goal of 100 Babies, and you are the architect of your own hell.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.53: Scoring Points does nothing, but you watch a digital integer increase and feel great.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.54: Repeat the same action until the bar is full, and the Experience Grind welcomes you to middle management.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.55: A Gold Sink is designed purely to delete the wealth you spent hours accumulating.
frizzlebob_s_mission_control.56: The Hero Must Survive, so good thing you're not the hero.

the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.1: Flip a coin for The Rib-Breaker, and if heads, the fall breaks your ribs.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.2: The Youngest Brother has been losing, so the spirit of his father begins to mutiny against this servitude.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.3: The Tyrant Brother forces the boy to attack the strongest, and would as lief he break his neck as his finger.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.4: The Old Servant has lost his teeth in your service, so sacrifice him to fully heal another character.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.5: Whenever The Exile takes adversity from the environment, he finds books in running brooks.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.6: As a weasel sucks eggs, The Melancholy Sad-Sack sucks melancholy out of a song to restore his own ego.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.7: When The Weeping Stag is losing, his velvet friends abandon him, so sweep on, fat and greasy citizens.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.8: The Motley Fool confuses the enemy, so they must speak in rhymes, and wise men do foolishly.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.9: Ganymede switches strength and wit at will, a counterfeit man with a swashing and martial outside.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.10: Aliena is content to share the play with Ganymede, but she cannot go no further.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.11: The Shepherd earns gold as a true laborer, and he will eat what he earns and wear what he gets.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.12: The God of Marriage must make conclusion of these strange events, and the most pairs wins.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.13: Ill met by moonlight, The Fairy King is invisible and will overhear your conference.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.14: The Fairy Queen cannot attack any character as beautiful as an ass.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.15: The Hobgoblin will randomize the next attack, and Lord, what fools these targets are.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.16: The Changeling Boy causes a custody dispute, and she never had a sweeter changeling.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.17: The Ass-Head has the confidence, not the intelligence, so he is immune to insults.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.18: Read the prologue of The Carpenter aloud, and if you stumble, you played it like a child on a recorder.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.19: The Lion is no such thing, just a man with a gentle roar, as other men are.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.20: The Wall blocks all attacks, but through the chink poor souls are content to whisper.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.21: The more you spurn The Tall One, the more she buffs you, so use her but as your spaniel.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.22: The Short One is but little, but against the taller she is a fierce vixen.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.23: With The Purple Flower on sleeping eye-lids laid, you must defend the next played, regardless of team.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.24: When The Moon is waning, all magic will end, but the dog is my dog.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.25: The Bachelor deals paper bullets based on the words in your insult, and will live a bachelor.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.26: Swear you love The Lady Tongue and suffer the burn, because she had rather hear her dog bark at a crow.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.27: The Bastard creates a rumor that prevents two from teaming up, because he is a plain-dealing villain.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.28: The Drunkard will fabricate evidence of a vile encounter, but he has drunk to-day.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.29: The Constable can only succeed at the wrong task, O that he had been writ down an ass!
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.30: The Headborough is a good old man, sir, who will support Dogberry and add confusion by talking.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.31: The Slandered Bride died defiled, but she does live, and returns fully healed.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.32: Let her be secretly kept in, and The Friar's Plan will convert slander into guilt on the attacker.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.33: With The Masked Ladies, which is which? I am your husband, if you like.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.34: The Penitent hangs an epitaph to mourn the death by slanderous tongues, and so gains attack.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.35: Benedick challenges Claudio to The Challenge and does not jest, so the loser loses the weapon.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.36: Born under The Dancing Star, you resolve the merry war if both players are smiling.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.37: Peace? The Prince of Cats hates the word, so attack him and he will strike back instantly.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.38: Kill The Joker and you shall find him a grave man with a plague on all houses.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.39: The Peacemaker will part fools and their swords, but you know not what you do.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.40: You bite your thumb at us, sir? Then you must attack The Thumb-Biter in a civil brawl.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.41: With The Lover it is either double or kill self, because he is fortune's fool!
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.42: It is too rash and too sudden, so The Saint will accelerate the game timer.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.43: The Nurse will delay delivery of the message, and Lord, how her head aches!
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.44: On The Rope Ladder you sneak into the enemy base without fighting, and the drudge toils in your delight.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.45: Buy instant death poison from The Apothecary, because his poverty, but not his will, consents.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.46: With The Sleeping Potion you appear dead, no warmth, no breath, until you wake up.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.47: The Happy Dagger is happy, because this is its sheath, and there it will rust.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.48: The Golden Statues end the game in a glooming peace where nobody wins and everyone feels sad.
the_bards_barnyard_beatdown.55: The Mask is a mistaken identity, so a targeted attack will redirect to the adjacent.

sonic_warfare_music_history_01.5: Not for art, The Bone Flute was a remote control for the human heart.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.6: The War Drum was the state before the state, because when hearts beat together, boundaries dissolve.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.7: As a musician The Shaman did not entertain, but managed the tribe's reality.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.8: Control The Echo, and your repetition of truth will define the boundaries of the world.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.9: Gregorian Chant allowed no harmony, because harmony implies more than one perspective.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.10: Banned for centuries, The Tritonus is the Devil in music, because tension is dangerous.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.11: The Pipe Organ was the most expensive machine, with the voice of God and the budget of the State.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.12: In Hildegard's Vision the only way to break the rules was to claim God wrote them.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.13: The Fugue is not a song but dialectical logic, a trap where voices invert and combine.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.14: The Deaf Composer is proof that music lives in mental architecture, not sound.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.15: Before the character even speaks, The Leitmotif tells you exactly how to feel.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.16: In Bayreuth they dim the lights and hide the orchestra, so the audience does not observe but is absorbed.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.17: At The Crossroads the deal is real, even if the Devil is a metaphor.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.18: For The 27 Club the pattern is the point, and the gifts consume the vessel that carries them.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.19: The 12-Bar Loop will repeat, not from laziness, but from the insistence that the suffering is real.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.20: Why does The Blue Note hurt when it should not work? Because it is true.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.21: The Turned Back played for the music, not them, and if they did not get it, that was their problem.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.22: Love Supreme is a spiritual practice using the saxophone as a prayer wheel.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.23: The Improviser has to be ahead of his own understanding, because comfortable is wrong.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.24: The Session is a collective mind with no rehearsal, and discovery happens in the gaps.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.25: Payola is illegal when you bribe a DJ, but legal when you buy a playlist.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.26: The Teen Idol carries the music without carrying the threat, because safe and pretty is profitable.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.27: The Cover Version will sanitize the raw emotion for a broader market and keep the money.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.28: Play it on the TOP 40 until they like it, because familiarity breeds purchase.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.29: The Amen Break built entire genres in an infinite loop, and the drummer died broke.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.30: Is The Sampler theft? No, it is collage, because the Bronx used the past as a brickyard.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.31: The Crate Digger will unearth the break that everyone else walked past.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.32: The law did not evolve to protect artists, so Copyright Bot will protect the owners of the catalog.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.33: The Algorithm does not care what you like, only what you won't skip, and that leads to sameness.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.34: In the Loudness War everything is loud, so nothing is urgent.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.35: Just keep the vibe steady, because on The Playlist the artist is irrelevant.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.36: The goal of Retention Rate is to keep you here, mildly satisfied, forever.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.37: Some say 440 Hz creates subtle psychological dissonance, a frequency for workers, not dreamers.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.38: Maybe 432 Hz is the vibration of the universe, maybe a placebo, but it feels slower.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.39: Rock stars in Laurel Canyon with fathers in military intelligence? Just a coincidence, surely.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.40: Backmasking is a hidden command the subconscious hears, or maybe just noise, so do it.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.41: He worked from The Hospital Bed until the end, ignored by the industry and canonized by the culture.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.42: She did not change the notes, she changed the subject, and The Respect was suddenly a demand.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.43: For The Chameleon the mask is the self, so kill the character before they get bored.
sonic_warfare_music_history_01.44: In The Silence the music is the coughing of the audience.

symphonic_savagery.1: The Monophonic Monastery limits you to one single melodic line, because tonality did not exist yet.
symphonic_savagery.2: Gregorian Chant hypnotized the arena until polyphony ruined everything.
symphonic_savagery.3: Thomas Tallis overbooked the ring with The 40-Part Motet, and clergymen found it impossibly chaotic.
symphonic_savagery.4: The Renaissance Patron will fund a secular madrigal distraction and buy off the referee.
symphonic_savagery.5: The Harpsichord was weaponized by the elite to pluck your nerves, until the piano replaced it.
symphonic_savagery.6: In Sonata Form you state a theme, develop it in the middle, and lazily restate it at the end.
symphonic_savagery.7: In The Concerto Duel spotlight-hungry performers tag in a solo instrument to dominate the orchestra.
symphonic_savagery.8: Common Time resets the match rhythm to an inescapable, predictable drudgery.
symphonic_savagery.9: Hold your submission lock indefinitely with The Sustaining Pedal and its unrelenting sustain.
symphonic_savagery.10: Atonality and Serialism remove the musical key entirely, so attacks cannot be blocked.
symphonic_savagery.11: Extended Technique is rule-breaking, so use the instrument as a blunt percussion weapon.
symphonic_savagery.12: The Darmstadt School lectures the crowd until they boo, because unlistenable is sheer elitist power.
symphonic_savagery.13: Haydn wrote so many good quartets that The String Quartet is an inescapable team assault on later composers.
symphonic_savagery.14: The Brass Quintet is built to maximize sheer sonic impact and blow out your eardrums.
symphonic_savagery.15: In The Piano Trio a violin, a cello and a piano strike simultaneously as a tightly knit assault unit.
symphonic_savagery.16: The Woodwind Cartel chokes you out with reeds, and adding a horn is the deception.
symphonic_savagery.17: Summon The Symphony Orchestra and remember, not all orchestral music is classical music!
symphonic_savagery.18: From the rafters an Ethereal Choir will elevate the perceived divine importance of a piece.
symphonic_savagery.19: The Cartoon Conductor battles the orchestra with frantic baton swings to force them into compliance.
symphonic_savagery.20: Dramatic Timpani interrupt any promo, so the audience knows a massive hit is coming.
symphonic_savagery.21: A counterpoint hold by Johann Sebastian Bach is relentless, inescapable and mathematically merciless.
symphonic_savagery.22: Everyone else was forced to follow the rules Joseph Haydn built, strictly in Sonata Form.
symphonic_savagery.23: With a massive chorus of hallelujah, G.F. Handel will prematurely declare your inevitable victory.
symphonic_savagery.24: Many musicologists now believe Bach did not compose Toccata and Fugue at all.
symphonic_savagery.25: Without looking, Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart counters your finishing move perfectly.
symphonic_savagery.26: Trash talk? Ludwig van Beethoven ignores it entirely and attacks with pure Romantic fury.
symphonic_savagery.27: Fryderyk Chopin strikes the piano so blisteringly fast that the crowd is dazzled.
symphonic_savagery.28: With Impractical Musical Skills you do something incredibly difficult just to flex on the crowd.

cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.1: Every decade The Decennial Oracle summons itself to remind you that your favorite movie is trash.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.2: The Director's Cut steals all credit from the writer and crew, because it's about the process.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.3: The masses in The Herd Consensus demand the same comfortable myth they have already purchased.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.4: Under The Regional Bias every nation has a proven greatest film that no one outside has ever seen.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.5: Citizen Sled-Dog is the peak of human art, so for five decades you debate the meaning of a child's toy.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.6: The critics decided that Spiral Pigeon, a film about male obsession, was the new objective truth.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.7: Three hours of real-time kitchen chores in Potato-Peeling Poodle obliterate capitalist entertainment.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.8: In Bicycle-Thief Fox cinematic power comes from making you feel terrible about post-war poverty.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.9: Monolith Macaque upgrades your intelligence and alienates you from everyone else at the table.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.10: Tokyo Turtle Story achieves cinematic perfection by placing a camera off the floor and not moving it.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.11: Sacrifice your own to protect ungrateful peasants, and Seven Macaques grants immortal legendary status.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.12: Directors love nothing more than Octo-Auteur, a film about how hard it is to be a director.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.13: Wind-Blown Pig adjusts the past to suit Americans, and the myth is immune to critical re-evaluation.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.14: Forfeit your hand to Mafia Pug, or wake up with your favorite card destroyed.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.15: Every time you feel a shred of childhood nostalgia, Galactic Penguin extracts real-world currency.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.16: You weep over Sinking Hippo, an entirely avoidable tragedy built on teenage emotional labor.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.17: In Possessed Chihuahua weaponized Catholic guilt is the most effective mechanism for cinematic terror.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.18: Hard-Dying Hound reclassifies your peaceful holiday as an explosive combat zone. Yippee-ki-yay.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.19: Hot Saxophone Hyena gains immunity to critical logic by declaring nobody's perfect!
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.20: Wooden Woodpecker tells a beautiful lie, so you believe in wishing stars while turning into a donkey.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.21: In Rules of the Game Rooster the upper class collapses in a misunderstanding over a romantic affair.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.22: Nosferatu Bat is an illegal rip-off of Dracula that survives even if a court orders it destroyed.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.23: Eisenstein invented modern film editing in Potemkin Pelican just to legitimize a state revolution.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.24: Look at raw, unscripted mechanical reality, because Camera-Eye Chameleon strips all narrative illusions.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.25: Stagecoach Stallion pushes you out of your territory for a heroic, highly sanitized origin myth.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.26: With Replicant Raccoon the scientists agreed that our most likely future is corporate dystopian depression.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.27: In Brokeback Bovine all combat is resolved through repressed longing and societal pressure.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.28: In Shawshank Seagull patience and a rock hammer conquer all systemic injustice, every Sunday afternoon.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.29: With Pather Panchali Tiger the West had to admit that cinema existed outside their bubble.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.30: No player may attack in Spring Town Panda. You can only sigh deeply and reflect on broken marriages.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.31: Housemaid Cat slowly poisons you from the inside while cleaning your house.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.32: In Hong Kong Action Dragon true brotherhood requires shooting people in slow motion.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.33: In Underdevelopment Iguana the bourgeois observe the outcome without ever taking responsibility for it.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.34: In Red Light Armadillo trash becomes gold and logic becomes an illegal move.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.35: Prisoner Llama exposes the extraction of labor, then destroys your most expensive capital-generating unit.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.36: In Pancho Villa Vulture everyone is revealed to be a flawed, violent opportunist.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.37: Hanging Rock Kangaroo leaves abruptly, because the continent simply eats people.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.38: The hobbit-filled New Zealand tourism myth is brutally shattered by Once Were Wombats.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.39: Orson Welles steals Third Man Bulldog with five minutes of screen time and a monologue about the Swiss.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.40: Destroy Holy Grail Parrot completely and it is only a flesh wound, so it continues to shout insults.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.41: Marketa Lazarova Lynx confuses you with non-linear poetry until you forfeit out of exhaustion.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.42: In Teddy Bear Boar you fill out a form in triplicate, and failure results in immediate arrest.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.43: You have nowhere to move, because Round-Up Wolf extracts power through geometric intimidation.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.44: Come and See Bear is the total, uncompromised destruction of the glorious war movie.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.45: Iranian Deer accidentally predicted an actual real-world revolution, and fueled it.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.46: Night Counting Camel steals artifacts from the ancient dead to sell for immediate, short-term survival.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.47: Halfon Hill Sloth ignores all combat and avoids authority through pure comedic incompetence.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.48: Pay a heavy toll to Dry Summer Tortoise, because controlling the water means controlling the myth.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.49: Phantom Carriage Reindeer extracts morality by threatening you with the Grim Reaper's Uber service.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.50: Out of stubborn, frozen spite, Unknown Moose refuses to die.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.51: Nature Puffin escapes sterile aging by merging with the mythological landscape.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.52: In Flickering Walrus violent gangsters are lovable, quirky neurotics who blow up their own resources.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.53: The Ballot Box Badger wins any tie-breaker with skewed demographics and self-selection. See? Bias!
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.54: For The Retrospective Rat what was brilliant is boring, because they're erasing the past!
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.55: The elites of The Genre Pigeonhole refuse to let aliens, ghosts, or laughter sit at the adult table.
cinematic_kayfabizarro_2.56: The Wikipedia Weasel nullifies any argument with subjective opinions disguised as objective data.

ignore_dystopia.18: The Negativity Tax charges a little adrenaline per scroll and collects it all day.

ignore_dystopia.20: The Engagement Yield harvests paralysis, and it monetizes better than action ever would.

ignore_dystopia.29: The Alarm Bell keeps the threat response warm, because a scared mind is a steerable mind.
ignore_dystopia.30: The Cortisol Economy sells the spike, then sells the relief, to the exact same customer.
ignore_dystopia.31: Fear shrinks attention to The Narrowed View, where long plans die.
ignore_dystopia.32: The Obedient Pulse frightens people, then offers whoever promises to make it stop.
ignore_dystopia.33: In The Anecdote Engine a frightening story outweighs boring statistics even when they are the truth.

ignore_dystopia.35: In The Cherry Orchard every individual fact checks out, and the overall picture is false.
ignore_dystopia.36: A story repeated until it feels true is The Felt Statistic, and nobody asks for the actual rate.
ignore_dystopia.37: For months the body is at low-grade threat, because The Standing Alarm never stands down.
ignore_dystopia.38: The Shortened Breath keeps your breathing high and tight, because a calm state is a threat.

ignore_dystopia.42: If you repeat There Is No Alternative, imagining one feels inherently naive.
ignore_dystopia.43: The animal in The Trained Surrender stops trying long before the door opens.

ignore_dystopia.45: You trade the burden of choosing for The Surrendered Wheel and the comfort of being driven.
ignore_dystopia.46: The feed decides what is true in The Outsourced Verdict, so you never carry the doubt yourself.

embrace_protopia.25: The Unknown Face is not a threat but a possible ally with a different toolbox.
embrace_protopia.26: Most cooperation starts embarrassingly small, with The First Hello.
embrace_protopia.27: Your nervous system thinks The Risk of Being Soft-Blocked is death, but it is not.
embrace_protopia.28: Go first, because every ally in The Widened Circle was a stranger until somebody did.

embrace_protopia.30: Wonder costs less than hope when you frame it as The Cheap Experiment.
embrace_protopia.31: Curiosity treats The Wrong Answer as data, not defeat, so be wrong a lot.
embrace_protopia.32: Fear shrinks attention, but The Widening Mind lets interest expand it.
embrace_protopia.33: The Logged Observation is what you actually saw, not what the headline said you would see.

embrace_protopia.36: Trust The Track Record, a page of your own, over a year of someone else's predictions.
